safety_banner.title: Informational reference only — not medical advice.
safety_banner.bullet_1: These results match FDA drug-label indications to a situation. They are <1>not a recommendation</1> and <3>not an FDA endorsement</3>.
safety_banner.bullet_2: This is <1>not a drug-interaction checker</1>. Read each label’s full warnings, and check with a pharmacist or clinician before combining medicines.
safety_banner.bullet_3: In an emergency, or if symptoms are severe or worsening, <1>contact a medical professional or call emergency services</1>.

remedy_safety_note.title: Informational only — not medical advice.
remedy_safety_note.body_1: These remedies have limited or mixed evidence, are not FDA-evaluated, and are not a substitute for professional care. Check with a clinician before using any of them, and before combining one with a medication you already take.
remedy_safety_note.body_2: In an emergency, or if symptoms are severe or worsening, <1>seek real medical care — call emergency services</1>.

disclaimer_modal.title: Before you use the Drug Reference
disclaimer_modal.intro: This tool shows general health information from official <1>FDA drug labels</1> and matches symptoms to over-the-counter options. It is provided for <3>information only</3>.
disclaimer_modal.bullet_1: It is <1>not medical advice</1> and not a substitute for a doctor, pharmacist, or nurse.
disclaimer_modal.bullet_2: It is <1>not a drug-interaction checker</1>. Always read each product’s full label and check with a professional before combining medicines.
disclaimer_modal.bullet_3: Situation matches come from label text, not clinical recommendations — they can be incomplete or include products you wouldn’t expect.
disclaimer_modal.bullet_4: Always follow the directions on the <1>actual product you have</1>; dosages and warnings differ between products.
disclaimer_modal.bullet_5: In an emergency, or if symptoms are severe, worsening, or you’re unsure, <1>contact a medical professional or call emergency services</1>.
disclaimer_modal.footnote: Data is from openFDA (U.S. FDA, public domain). NOMAD is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FDA.
